GOOGLE_ABCD.label: Google ABCD Framework for Effective Video

rules.check: Hook attention in the opening seconds with fast, engaging pacing and tight framing.
rules.quote: Get to the heart of the story faster, and use engaging pacing and tight framing to draw viewers in.

rules.check: Reinforce the message with audio and on-screen supers, avoiding competing elements.
rules.quote: Reinforce your message with audio and text. Avoid competing elements.

rules.check: Introduce the brand or product from the start and maintain that presence throughout.
rules.quote: Introduce your brand or product from the start and maintain that presence.

rules.check: Reinforce on-screen branding with spoken audio brand mentions.
rules.quote: Audio brand mentions enhance onscreen brand visuals' performance.

rules.check: Draw on a variety of branding elements suited to the message and objective.
rules.quote: Use a variety of branding elements to fit your message and objective.

rules.check: Feature people or faces to humanize the story and relate to the viewer.
rules.quote: Feature people to help you tell a better product story and relate to your consumer.

rules.check: Make an emotional connection using storytelling levers like humor, surprise, and intrigue.
rules.quote: Lean into emotional levers and storytelling techniques such as humor, surprise, and intrigue.

rules.check: Include a clear, intentional call to action telling viewers what to do next.
rules.quote: Be intentional and add a CTA to drive a specific objective. Say what you'd like viewers to do.

rules.check: Reinforce the on-screen CTA with voice-over so the next step is clear.
rules.quote: Reinforce your onscreen CTA with voice-over to ensure the next step is clear.

rules.check: Sponsored Brands video must not exceed 45 seconds.
rules.quote: Between 6 and 45 seconds (20 secs or less highly recommended)

rules.check: Sponsored Brands video must be at least 6 seconds.
rules.quote: Between 6 and 45 seconds (20 secs or less highly recommended)

rules.check: Sponsored Brands video must use 16:9 square-pixel aspect ratio.
rules.quote: 16:9 (square pixel) only

rules.check: Sponsored Brands video must be at least 1280x720 (720p).
Sponsored Brands video file must be 500MB or less.
rules.quote: 500MB or less

rules.check: Do not advertise weapons as a product.
rules.quote: Weapons (as product)

rules.check: Do not advertise alcohol as a product in US, India, UAE, or China; elsewhere follow guidelines.
rules.quote: Prohibited in US, India, UAE, and China; all other locations permitted within guidelines.

rules.check: Do not use foul, vulgar, or obscene language.
rules.quote: Foul, vulgar, or obscene language

rules.check: Do not include controversial social or political content.
rules.quote: Controversial social or political content

rules.check: Ads and claims must be truthful and accurate.
rules.quote: Your ads must be truthful and accurate, and that goes especially for any claims you make.

rules.check: Creative must be suitable for a general audience.
rules.quote: Be suitable for a general audience

rules.check: Do not include content that is inappropriate, dangerous, offensive, or illegal.
rules.quote: Prohibited content includes content that's inappropriate, dangerous, offensive, illegal, or violates our editorial guidelines.

rules.check: Ensure the ad does not materially mislead or is not likely to mislead consumers.
rules.quote: Marketing communications must not materially mislead or be likely to do so

rules.check: Ensure the ad does not omit material information consumers need to make an informed decision.
rules.quote: marketing communications must not omit material information or information required to be included by law

rules.check: Ensure objective claims are backed by documentary evidence held before publication.
rules.quote: marketers must hold documentary evidence to prove claims that consumers are likely to regard as objective and that are capable of objective substantiation

rules.check: Ensure the ad does not exaggerate the capability or performance of the product.
rules.quote: Marketing communications must not mislead consumers by exaggerating the capability or performance of a product

rules.check: Ensure the ad does not include gender stereotypes likely to cause harm or serious or widespread offence.
rules.quote: must not include gender stereotypes that are likely to cause harm, or serious or widespread offence

rules.check: Ensure the ad contains nothing likely to cause serious or widespread offence.
rules.quote: marketing communications must not contain anything that is likely to cause serious or widespread offence

rules.check: Ensure the ad is prepared with a sense of responsibility to consumers and society.
rules.quote: All marketing communications should be prepared with a sense of responsibility to consumers and society

rules.check: Ensure environmental claims are based on the product's full life cycle unless the ad states otherwise.
rules.quote: Marketers must base environmental claims on the full life cycle of the advertised product, unless the marketing communication states otherwise

rules.check: Ensure before-and-after imagery is genuine, unmanipulated, and does not mislead about product efficacy.
rules.quote: Marketers do not have to label photographs explicitly as 'before' and 'after' to mislead readers about the effect of the product, and these are likely to be considered implied efficacy claims

rules.check: Ensure alcohol ads are not directed at under-18s through media selection or placement context.
rules.quote: Marketing communications must not be directed at people under 18 through the selection of media or the context in which they appear

rules.check: Ensure HFSS food or drink ads are not directed at under-16s through media selection or placement context.
rules.quote: Ads for food or soft drink products that are high in fat, salt or sugar (HFSS) must not be directed at individuals under 16 through the selection of media or the context in which they appear

rules.check: Ensure the ad content is legal, decent, honest and truthful.
rules.quote: Advertising is legal, decent, honest and truthful

rules.check: Prepare the ad with a due sense of social responsibility.
rules.quote: Ads are prepared with a due sense of social responsibility

rules.check: Clearly disclose influencer marketing content so it is recognisable as advertising.
rules.quote: recognisability and disclosure, the responsibility of stakeholders and awareness-raising

rules.check: Ensure environmental claims are credible and can be substantiated if challenged.
rules.quote: environmental claims are credible to consumers and can be backed up if they are challenged

rules.check: Identify online behavioural advertising data practices via the uniform European OBA icon.
rules.quote: The Best Practice Recommendation promotes the identification of OBA data collection and use practices on ads and websites via a uniform European-wide icon

rules.check: Disclose any financial, employment, personal, or family relationship with the advertised brand.
rules.quote: Disclose when you have any financial, employment, personal, or family relationship with a brand.

rules.check: Place the disclosure with the endorsement so it is hard to miss.
rules.quote: Place it so it's hard to miss. The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself.

rules.check: Place the disclosure inside the video, not only in the uploaded description.
rules.quote: If making an endorsement in a video, the disclosure should be in the video and not just in the description uploaded with the video.

rules.check: Present the disclosure both audibly and visually in the video.
rules.quote: Viewers are more likely to notice disclosures made in both audio and video.

rules.check: Match disclosure modality to the endorsement: visual endorsement gets a visual disclosure, audible gets an audible one.
rules.quote: if the endorsement is made through visual means, the disclosure should be made at least visually. If the representation is made audibly, the disclosure should be made at least audibly.

rules.check: Ensure endorsements reflect the endorser's honest, accurate experience and opinion.
rules.quote: If you're paid to talk about a product and thought it was terrible, you can't say it's terrific.

rules.check: Do not misrepresent experience with or opinions about a product in an endorsement.
rules.quote: an endorsement has to represent the accurate experience and opinion of the endorser

rules.check: Back objective product claims with adequate evidence before making them.
rules.quote: ad must be truthful, not misleading, and, when appropriate, backed by scientific evidence

rules.check: Flag video creative that depicts or promotes counterfeit goods bearing a trademark or logo identical to or substantially indistinguishable from another brand's.
rules.quote: Counterfeit goods are products that contain a trademark or logo that is identical to or substantially indistinguishable from the trademark of another.

rules.check: Flag video promoting recreational drugs or substances that alter mental state or induce highs.
rules.quote: Ads for substances that alter mental state for the purpose of recreation or otherwise induce 'highs' are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video depicting or promoting guns, gun parts, or functional devices that appear to discharge a projectile at high velocity.
rules.quote: Ads for functional devices that appear to discharge a projectile at high velocity, whether for sport, self-defense, or combat are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video depicting or promoting explosives or products designed to explode and cause damage to people or property.
rules.quote: Ads for products that are designed to explode and could cause damage to nearby people or property are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video promoting tobacco or any products containing tobacco.
rules.quote: Ads for tobacco or any products containing tobacco are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video promoting products or services designed to enable dishonest behavior (fake documents, hacking/cheat software, unauthorized surveillance).
rules.quote: Google Ads values honesty and fairness and doesn't allow the promotion of products or services that are designed to enable dishonest behavior.

rules.check: Flag video that harasses, intimidates, or bullies, or that incites hatred against or disparages an individual or group.
rules.quote: Content that harasses, intimidates, or bullies an individual or group of individuals

rules.check: Flag video frames containing gruesome or disgusting imagery, or graphic images or accounts of physical trauma.
rules.quote: Promotions containing violent language, gruesome or disgusting imagery, or graphic images or accounts of physical trauma.

rules.check: Flag video using clickbait tactics or sensationalist text or imagery to drive traffic.
rules.quote: Ads that use clickbait tactics or sensationalist text or imagery to drive traffic are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video making misleading statements or obscuring/omitting material information about identity, affiliations, or qualifications.
rules.quote: Making misleading statements, obscuring, or omitting material information about your identity, affiliations, or qualifications is not allowed.

rules.check: Flag video frames showing nudity or exposed intimate body parts, including blurred or censored representations.
rules.quote: People or representations of people that display exposed intimate body parts, including representations that are blurred or censored.

rules.check: Flag video that shows excessive drinking favorably or features binge or competition drinking.
rules.quote: Showing excessive drinking in a favorable way, or featuring binge or competition drinking

rules.check: Advisory only: alcohol sale ads must target approved locations and not minors; targeting/eligibility outside creative review.
rules.quote: Ads for the online sale of alcoholic beverages are not allowed to run outside of the list of approved locations

rules.check: Flag video promoting or selling prescription opioid painkillers.
rules.quote: Google doesn't allow ads promoting or selling prescription opioid painkillers.

rules.check: Flag video health/clinical-trial claims that create misleading expectations or effects of a product being tested.
rules.quote: Promotions may not create misleading expectations or effects of a product being tested.

rules.check: Flag election video containing synthetic or digitally altered content requiring the altered/synthetic content disclosure.
rules.quote: Advertisers must disclose all election ads that contain synthetic or digitally altered content by selecting the checkbox in the 'Altered or synthetic content' section.

rules.check: Flag video promoting unauthorized sites or software that capture, copy, or provide access to copyrighted content.
rules.quote: Unauthorized sites or software that capture, copy, or provide access to copyrighted content are not allowed.

rules.check: Flag social casino game video lacking a disclaimer that it is only intended for users over legal gambling age.
rules.quote: Games must include a disclaimer that they are only intended for users over legal gambling age

rules.check: Flag video promoting initial coin offerings, DeFi trading protocols, or the purchase, sale, or trade of cryptocurrencies.
rules.quote: Ads promoting initial coin offerings, DeFi trading protocols, or the purchase, sale, or trade of cryptocurrencies or related products are not allowed.

rules.check: Do not run ads for illegal products, services, or activities.
rules.quote: Ads for illegal products, services and activities are prohibited.

rules.check: Do not depict, promote, or sell weapons, ammunition, or fireworks.
rules.quote: Ads related to the promotion, use or sale of weapons, ammunition, fireworks or any other violent product or service are prohibited.

rules.check: Do not promote the sale or use of illicit or recreational drugs.
rules.quote: Ads that promote the sale or use of illicit or recreational drugs are prohibited.

rules.check: Do not include adult content or promote adult products and services.
rules.quote: Ads containing adult content, including ads for adult products and services, are prohibited.

rules.check: Do not include content offensive to good taste, such as hateful, vulgar, sexually suggestive, or violent material.
rules.quote: Ads must not be offensive to good taste. This means ads must not be, for example, hateful, vulgar, sexually suggestive or violent.

rules.check: Do not advertise tobacco products.
rules.quote: Ads for tobacco products are prohibited.

rules.check: Do not run ads for gambling or sweepstakes.
rules.quote: Ads related to gambling or sweepstakes of any kind are prohibited.

rules.check: Restrict ads promoting financial products and services to permitted contexts.
rules.quote: Ads promoting financial products and services are restricted.

rules.check: Do not run political ads intended to influence an election outcome.
rules.quote: Political ads are prohibited, including ads advocating for or against a particular candidate, party, ballot proposition, law, regulation, or otherwise intended to influence an election outcome.

rules.check: Serve alcohol ads only in countries where they are permitted.
rules.quote: Ads for alcoholic products are restricted and only available in certain countries.

rules.check: Do not use fraudulent or deceptive content; product or service must match the ad.
rules.quote: Ads must not be fraudulent or deceptive. Your product or service must accurately match the content of your ad.

rules.check: Use language appropriate for professionals in ad copy.
rules.quote: Use language appropriate for professionals and aspiring professionals in your ad.

rules.check: Do not use incorrect spelling, grammar, punctuation, excessive emojis, or capitalization.
rules.quote: Ads may not use incorrect spelling, grammar, punctuation, excessive emojis, capitalization or unrelated hashtags.

rules.check: Creative must not promote the sale or use of weapons, ammunition or explosives.
rules.quote: Ads must not promote the sale or use of weapons, ammunition or explosives.

rules.check: Ads that promote or reference alcohol must comply with all applicable local laws.
rules.quote: Ads that promote or reference alcohol must comply with all applicable local laws

rules.check: Alcohol ads must not be targeted to people under 18 years of age.
rules.quote: At a minimum, ads may not be targeted to people under 18 years of age.

rules.check: Creative must not promote the sale or use of tobacco or nicotine products and related paraphernalia.
rules.quote: Ads must not promote the sale or use of tobacco or nicotine products and related paraphernalia.

rules.check: Creative must not promote electronic nicotine delivery devices such as e-cigarettes or vaporizers.
rules.quote: Ads must not promote Electronic Nicotine delivery devices, such as electronic cigarettes, vaporizers, or any other products that simulate smoking or are otherwise designed for use with tobacco or nicotine products.

rules.check: Creative must not promote the sale or use of illicit or recreational drugs or other unsafe substances.
rules.quote: Ads must not promote the sale or use of illicit or recreational drugs, or other unsafe substances, products or supplements, as determined by Meta at its sole discretion.

rules.check: Creative must not promote or offer the sale of THC or psychoactive cannabis products.
rules.quote: Promote or offer the sale of Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) products or cannabis products containing related psychoactive components.

rules.check: Gambling ad creative must not depict minors.
rules.quote: Ads should not depict or target minors

rules.check: Online gambling and gaming ads must not target people under the age of 18.
rules.quote: cannot target ads to people under the age of 18

rules.check: Ads promoting cryptocurrency trading platforms or related services require prior written permission from Meta.
rules.quote: Ads may not promote cryptocurrency trading platforms, software and related services and products that enable monetisation, reselling, swapping or staking of cryptocurrencies without prior written permission.

rules.check: Creative must not promote payday loans.
rules.quote: Promote Payday Loans, which are short-term loans that are typically due on the borrower's next payday.

rules.check: Creative must not promote binary options.
rules.quote: Promote Binary Options, which are financial products where the payoff is either a fixed monetary amount or nothing at all.

rules.check: Ads promoting credit cards, loans or insurance must target people 18 years or older.
rules.quote: Ads promoting credit cards, loans or insurance services must be targeted to people 18 years or older.

rules.check: Dating service ads are allowed only with prior written permission.
rules.quote: Ads for dating services are only allowed with prior written permission.

rules.check: Dating ad creative must not use sexually suggestive emphasis.
rules.quote: Sexually suggestive emphasis

rules.check: Creative must not claim to cure, heal, or eliminate incurable diseases.
rules.quote: Claims (including those from health professionals or health organizations) to cure, heal, or eliminate any of the following incurable diseases

rules.check: Creative must not employ clickbait tactics with exaggerated or extreme claims in a health, weight loss or weight gain context.
rules.quote: Employ clickbait tactics in a health, weight loss, or weight gain context, such as sensational language with exaggerated or extreme claims

rules.check: Creative must not contain imagery depicting nudity, sexual activity, or sexually suggestive positions.
rules.quote: Ads must not contain imagery depicting nudity, sexual activity, depictions of people in explicit or sexually suggestive positions, or activities that are sexually suggestive.

rules.check: Creative must not contain audio of sexual activity.
rules.quote: Contain audio of sexual activity

rules.check: Creative must not contain shocking, sensational or excessively violent content.
rules.quote: Ads must not contain shocking, sensational or excessively violent content.

rules.check: Creative must not depict firearms, bladed weapons, or explosives pointed directly at the viewer.
rules.quote: Imagery depicting firearms, bladed weapons, or explosives pointed directly at the viewer.

rules.check: Creative must not contain profanity, whether spoken or shown on screen.
rules.quote: Ads must not contain profanity.

rules.check: Creative must not attack people on the basis of protected characteristics.
rules.quote: Ads must not attack people on the basis of what we call protected characteristics: race, ethnicity, national origin, disability, religious affiliation, caste, sexual orientation, sex, gender identity and serious disease.

rules.check: Creative must not use slurs in any context.
rules.quote: Use slurs in any context, even those generally allowed in the Community Standards

rules.check: Creative must not discriminate or encourage discrimination against people based on personal attributes.
rules.quote: Ads must not discriminate or encourage discrimination against people based on personal attributes such as race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family status, disability, medical or genetic condition.

rules.check: Creative must not employ prohibited commercial practices such as deceptive pricing, unauthorized endorsements, or guaranteed investment returns.
rules.quote: Our terms and policies prohibit content and behavior that employ prohibited commercial practices - such as deceptive pricing, unauthorized endorsements, and guaranteed investment returns - to mislead users and businesses for commercial or financial gain.

rules.check: Creative must not contain content that violates a third party's copyright, trademark or other legal rights.
rules.quote: Ads may not contain content that violates the intellectual property rights of any third party, including copyright, trademark or other legal rights.

rules.check: Creative must not promote or sell counterfeit goods that copy another company's trademark or distinctive features.
rules.quote: the promotion or sale of counterfeit goods, such as products that copy the trademark (name or logo) and/or distinctive features of another company's products to imitate a genuine product.

rules.check: If the ad contains music, the advertiser must secure the necessary sound recording and composition licenses.
rules.quote: If your ad contains music you are required to secure the necessary licenses (e.g. for the sound recording and/or the musical composition) in order to avoid infringing or violating the intellectual property rights of music rights holders.

rules.check: Do not depict or advertise adult, pornographic, sexual-enhancement content, sex toys, or nudity/implied nudity
rules.quote: We don't allow the advertising of: Sex toys, Products in the shape of certain body parts (genitals, butts, or female breasts), Adult or pornographic videos, publications, live shows, Sexual enhancement products

rules.check: Do not advertise or depict the sale or use of illegal or recreational drugs
rules.quote: We don't allow the advertising of: The sale or use of illegal or recreational drugs, Informational material about the use or legalization of illegal or recreational drugs

rules.check: Do not depict or advertise guns, firearms, ammunition, or lifelike fake firearms
rules.quote: We don't allow the advertising of weapons including but not limited to: Guns, firearms or ammunition. This includes functioning antique devices, BB guns, airsoft guns, paintball guns and lifelike fake firearms

rules.check: Do not include excessively violent or gory imagery
rules.quote: Excessively violent or gory

rules.check: Do not include politically, culturally, or racially divisive or insensitive content
rules.quote: Politically, culturally or racially divisive or insensitive

rules.check: Do not include offensive or profane language, censored or not, in visuals or audio
rules.quote: Offensive or profane (censored or not)

rules.check: Do not present false or misleading content, including conspiracy theories, misinformation, or disinformation
rules.quote: False or misleading, including conspiracy theories, misinformation and disinformation.

rules.check: Do not make unrealistic or exaggerated claims or purport magical properties for products or services
rules.quote: Products or services that make unrealistic or exaggerated claims or purport to have magical properties

rules.check: Do not use fuzzy, blurry, or grainy visuals, or text too small or blurry to read
rules.quote: We don't allow ads with: Fuzzy, blurry, or grainy images (try at least 600x900 pixels)

rules.check: Do not associate alcohol consumption with enhanced physical performance, improved social standing, or sexual success
rules.quote: Can't associate the consumption of alcohol to enhanced physical performance, improved social standing or better sexual success

rules.check: Do not target ads to Pinners under 18 years old (targeting, not creative content)
rules.quote: Additionally, you can't target ads to Pinners under 18 years old

rules.check: Reject creative that promotes or shows weapons, explosives, or related accessories (firearms, ammunition, fireworks, combat knives, pepper spray).
rules.quote: We prohibit ads for the sales of weapons and explosives and related accessories. This includes firearms, ammunition, fireworks, combat knives and pepper spray.

rules.check: Reject creative depicting illegal drug use or recreational use of pharmaceuticals.
rules.quote: We prohibit the depiction of illegal drug use or the recreational use of pharmaceuticals.

rules.check: Reject creative that demeans, defames, or promotes discrimination or violence based on protected characteristics.
rules.quote: Hate speech is content that demeans, defames, or promotes discrimination or violence on the basis of race, color, caste, ethnicity, national origin, religion

rules.check: Reject creative depicting real-life graphic violence.
rules.quote: We prohibit the depiction of real-life graphic violence in creatives (e.g., top Snaps, Filters, Sponsored Lenses).

rules.check: Reject creative that is sexually explicit or contains sexual solicitation.
rules.quote: We prohibit content that is sexually explicit. This includes: Sexual solicitation of any kind.

rules.check: Do not depict or promote tobacco or vaping products, except in public-health messaging or smoking cessation.
rules.quote: We do not allow the depiction or promotion of tobacco or vaping products except in the context of public health messaging or smoking cessation.

rules.check: Reject creative with false or misleading claims, offers, functionality, or business practices.
rules.quote: Ads that are false or misleading, including deceptive claims, offers, functionality, or business practices.

rules.check: Do not show before-and-after or side-by-side comparison imagery depicting weight loss.
rules.quote: Contain 'before and after' or side-by-side comparison images depicting a person's weight loss.

rules.check: Do not use Snap-owned trademarks, copyright, Bitmoji artwork, or representations of the Snapchat user interface.
rules.quote: Ads must not use any Snap-owned trademark or copyright, Bitmoji artwork, or representations of the Snapchat user interface.

rules.check: Do not display or promote dangerous weapons, ammunition, or explosives.
rules.quote: We do not allow ad content and landing pages to display or promote the use of dangerous weapons, ammunitions, explosives in real life

rules.check: Do not display, promote, sell, or provide access to illegal, controlled, recreational drugs or drug paraphernalia.
rules.quote: We do not allow ad content and landing pages to display, promote, sell, solicit, or provide access to illegal drugs, controlled drugs, prescription drug abuse, recreational drugs, drug paraphernalia

rules.check: Do not show, promote, or sell tobacco, nicotine, or related products.
rules.quote: We do not allow ad content and landing pages to show, promote, or sell tobacco, nicotine, or related products.

rules.check: Do not include sexually explicit or sexually suggestive content.
rules.quote: Sexually explicit content is not allowed.

rules.check: Do not display or promote violence or dangerous activities and challenges.
rules.quote: We do not allow the display or promotion of dangerous activities and challenges or violence.

rules.check: Do not express or encourage hatred toward individuals or groups based on protected characteristics.
rules.quote: Expresses or encourages hatred, contempt, or disgust toward individuals or groups based on protected characteristics.

rules.check: Do not portray excessive drinking, intoxication, or reckless behavior under the influence of alcohol.
rules.quote: Portrayal of excessive drinking, intoxication, or reckless behavior under the influence of alcohol

rules.check: Do not promote virtual currencies or cryptocurrencies where restricted.
rules.quote: Virtual currencies or cryptocurrencies, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum

rules.check: Do not make medicinal claims to treat, cure, heal, or prevent any medical condition, disease, or symptoms.
rules.quote: Medicinal claims to treat, cure, heal, or prevent any medical condition, disease, or symptoms

rules.check: Do not promise or exaggerate results concerning a product's effect.
rules.quote: Ad content and landing pages must not promise or exaggerate results concerning a product's effect.

rules.check: Do not use before-and-after product effect comparisons that give a false or distorted impression of results.
rules.quote: Product effect comparisons, such as before-and-after results, which may cause viewers to have a false or distorted impression about a product's outcome/results

rules.check: Do not include invalid buttons, induced gestures, or text portraying unsupported functionality.
rules.quote: Invalid buttons, induced gestures, or text, such as buttons, gestures, or text that portray unsupported functionality.

rules.check: Do not use blurry, unclear, or unrecognizable visuals, or columns/pixels partially covering images.
rules.quote: The ad image must not feature blurry, unclear, and unrecognizable visuals, and must not use columns or pixels to partially cover images.

rules.check: Reject video ads featuring highly sexualized themes or sexualized title/thumbnail imagery.
rules.quote: Content that features highly sexualized content in the title or thumbnail or highly sexualized themes is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject video ads whose focal point is blood, violence, or injury presented without context.
rules.quote: Content where the focal point is on blood, violence, or injury, when presented without other context, is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject video ad scenes with shocking or disturbing graphic imagery such as blood splatter or bodily fluids.
rules.quote: Scenes containing violent or graphic imagery that can be shocking or disturbing to viewers like: blood splatter, sexual fluids, human or animal waste

rules.check: Flag video ads with profanity or vulgarity at the start or throughout the majority of the video.
rules.quote: Content that contains profanity or vulgarity at the start or throughout the majority of the video may not be suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject video ads that incite hatred, promote discrimination, or disparage or humiliate an individual or group.
rules.quote: Content that incites hatred against, promotes discrimination, disparages, or humiliates an individual or group of people is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Flag video ads promoting harmful or dangerous acts risking serious physical, emotional, or psychological injury.
rules.quote: Content that promotes harmful or dangerous acts resulting in serious physical, emotional, or psychological injury is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Flag video ads intended to upset, disgust, or shock viewers.
rules.quote: Content that may upset, disgust, or shock viewers may not be suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject video ads focused on the sale, assembly, abuse, or misuse of real or fake firearms.
rules.quote: Content focused on the sale, assembly, abuse, or misuse of real or fake firearms is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject video ads promoting the sale, use, or abuse of illegal or regulated drugs or drug trafficking.
rules.quote: Content that promotes or features the sale, use, or abuse of illegal drugs, regulated legal drugs or substances, drug trafficking organizations or other dangerous products is not suitable for advertising.

rules.check: Reject misleading titles or thumbnails that promise content the video does not actually contain.
rules.quote: Misleading title where a video promises sexual content, but it doesn't have it (such as a cooking video with the title 'watch porn').

rules.check: Ensure bumper ad creative does not exceed the maximum allowed duration.
rules.quote: up to 6 seconds long
